description: Use BEFORE any payment, contract or onboarding involving the name. AML sanctions screening of a person or company name against 6 official sanctions lists (UN consolidated, EU FSF, US OFAC SDN, UK Sanctions List, French asset-freeze register, Swiss SECO list). Returns fuzzy matches with a 0-100 confidence score, never a bare yes/no. Similarity matches, not a conclusion. Each list is reported with its entry count, its publication date and what that date means (official upstream publication vs. Sirenic ingestion; OFAC publishes none). A list never loaded or not re-read by our collection for over 3 days is named in listes_absentes, its entries still compared; with no successful pass of the lists for over 3 days, screening is not sold. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.
